خَطَفَى (assumed tropical:) Quickness in pace or going, (S, K,) of a camel, as though he were straining, or stretching, his neck, in going along; (S; [see 8;]) as also ↓ خَيْطَفَى , (K,) and ↓ خَيْطَفٌ . (JK, TA.) ―
-b2- See also the last of these words below.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
